name: fiction-studio
description: AI-powered short story creation system based on real story analysis data / 基于真实拆稿数据的AI短篇小说创作系统
author: Claude Code

skills.name: idea-generator
skills.description: Generate story ideas and plot concepts based on extensive inspiration libraries / 基于灵感库生成故事创意和情节概念

skills.name: story-structure
skills.description: Design story structures based on analyzed fiction patterns / 基于拆稿分析设计故事结构

skills.name: plot-builder
skills.description: Build detailed plots with conflicts, twists, and pacing / 构建详细情节，包含冲突、反转和节奏控制

skills.name: character-creator
skills.description: Create complex characters with depth, flaws, and growth arcs / 创建有深度、有缺陷、有成长弧的人物角色

skills.name: scene-writer
skills.description: Write compelling scenes with sensory details, dialogue, and pacing / 写出引人入胜的场景，包含感官细节、对话和节奏控制

skills.name: conflict-designer
skills.description: Design multi-layered conflicts with internal and external dimensions / 设计多层次冲突，包含内在和外在维度

skills.name: pacing-controller
skills.description: Control story pacing with sentence structure, scene length, and tension curves / 控制故事节奏，包含句式结构、场景长度和张力曲线

skills.name: story-analyzer
skills.description: Analyze existing stories to extract structure, techniques, and patterns / 分析现有故事，提取结构、技巧和模式

methodology.structure_analysis: 基于真实拆稿数据总结的结构规律
methodology.technique_extraction: 从实际作品中提炼的写作技巧
methodology.pattern_recognition: 识别可复用的故事模式
methodology.data_driven: 数据驱动的创作方法论

features.inspiration_generation: 灵感生成：支持世情、悬疑等多种类型
features.structure_templates: 结构模板：三幕式、时间循环、谜题揭秘等
features.conflict_design: 冲突设计：五层冲突体系，多维度叠加
features.character_systems: 人物系统：三层模型，成长弧光
features.scene_writing: 场景写作：7种场景类型，感官细节法
features.pacing_control: 节奏控制：4种节奏类型，张力曲线设计
features.twist_design: 反转设计：反转矩阵，多层反转技巧
features.story_analysis: 故事分析：完整拆解框架，技巧提取

use_cases: 学习短篇小说创作基础

installation.note: Install to your Claude Code plugins directory
